svg.title: End of a receiver graph with receiver output and analysis nodes
svg.desc: The receive filter output, optionally after an FFE, feeds the receiver output, the PAM-4 analyzer and the eye diagram. The fiber output feeds the TDECQ node. The analysis nodes and the FFE also take the transmitted symbols from the pattern source as reference. The SER is semi-analytic while sigma(t) is exact and counted otherwise.
